android.desc:
FalconAI: AI Movie & TV Search
The AI search engine for everything you want to watch. Stop scrolling through five apps to find one show.
FalconAI reads your intent and finds your movie, show or live channel in seconds. Ask for a dark thriller under two hours and get exact matches, not a list of genres.
AI search built for speed. Type or speak what you want and FalconAI finds it across every platform you use.
Live TV from the USA, UK and Canada. Stream live channels from the regions you care about, all inside one app.
Recommendations that get sharper every day. FalconAI studies your taste and improves with every search.
Voice control for your remote. Speak into your TV remote and skip the menus completely.
News and weather without leaving the app. Get instant AI summaries and your local forecast in one tap.
One app replaces five. FalconAI merges search, streaming, news and weather into a single fast experience. You spend your time watching, not searching.
Works on phones, tablets and TV devices. Same fast experience everywhere you watch.
FalconAI is how you find what to watch next. Download it and ask.
